title: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte arraignment for grave threats (Oct. 9, 2026)
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to attend the arraignment for her grave threats case at the Quezon City Regional Trial Court on Friday, October 9.

blocks.text: Barricades installed around QC court ahead of Sara Duterte arraignment
Steel barricades were installed around the Quezon City Hall of Justice Friday morning ahead of Vice President Sara Duterte's scheduled arraignment on a grave threat case.
The Quezon City Police District (QCPD) placed the railings to enforce rules prohibiting protests within a 200-meter radius of court buildings.
“Yun po ay security assistance po natin as requested by the Office of Judiciary Marshals,” QCPD spokesperson Police Major Jennifer Ganaban said in an interview on GMA News’ Unang Balita.
(That's our security assistance as requested by the Office of Judiciary Marshals.)
